properties.name: distributed-lock.enabled
properties.description: Whether distributed lock auto-configuration is active.

properties.name: distributed-lock.prefix
properties.description: Redis key prefix. A colon is appended when missing.

properties.name: distributed-lock.default-wait-time
properties.description: Default wait used by lock() and @DistributedLocked when waitTime is omitted.

properties.name: distributed-lock.watchdog-enabled
properties.description: Renew held locks before TTL expiry.

properties.name: distributed-lock.aop-order
properties.description: Spring AOP advisor order. Lower runs outside @Transactional by default.
